title: a backticked token that is not file-shaped (a branch, a skill name, a future folder, an import alias, a version) is not looked up as a path
source: intended: a cited path is a token that names a file, with an extension
intent: Branch names, skill names, folders the worker will create, import aliases and version-like names were rejected as ghost paths. Only a token whose last segment ends in a dot and a letter-led extension, with no leading @ and no trailing slash, is looked up.
